note: Langfuse was unavailable on this machine (Docker could not be installed), so spans were captured with a local OpenTelemetry file exporter instead of the Langfuse backend. The instrumentation under test is unchanged: server/app.py and observability/instrument.py emit standard OTel spans regardless of which consumer receives them. permalink therefore points at the committed span file (hw2-spans.jsonl) rather than a Langfuse URL. In that file the model identifier is redacted to <internal-model> because it names internal infrastructure; every span, attribute, and parent/child relationship is otherwise untouched.
